items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

items.title: Michael Carrick: Manchester United expected to sack head coach - BBC Sport
items.summary:
The following week, United were losing to Ipswich - another newly promoted side. Only a slip from Marcelino Nunez inside his own half allowed Cunha to tee up Fernandes for an undeserved equaliser.

The Portugal playmaker, who had just been crowned PFA Player of the Year for 2025-26, went on to complete a hat-trick in a 5-2 win.

He has scored just once - a penalty against Villa on Sunday - in the league since.

After the Ipswich win came a trip to Everton. [...] By the time of Martinez's outburst, Sesko and left-back Luke Shaw were injured. Marcus Rashford has not played since. The rotation at left-back that eventually led to Carrick starting five different players in that role was in full swing.

After conceding in the opening minute against Atletico, Como scored inside the first two in a 4-1 Champions League defeat for United. Fernandes came out afterwards and criticised Carrick's tactics. [...] After taking a 2-0 lead inside 10 minutes against Brighton in the EFL Cup, United were outplayed and beaten, thanks to two goals in four second-half minutes.

The fine margins United benefited from during Carrick's interim spell were now going against them, and his coaching staff - lauded months earlier - could not find an answer.

items.title: Man Utd Women are unbeaten in 11 games but there is still a striking issue to fix - The Athletic
items.summary:
Two months later, United are fifth in the table with three wins from their past five matches, four points off London City, who fill the third and final Champions League spot.

Sunday’s game encapsulated a lot of United’s improvements in recent months, as well as the struggles that still need to be addressed. [...] Because there was a time two months ago that United’s capacity to win was doubted, Olid’s start to life in the job blighted by a failure to win any of her four pre-season matches, followed by defeats against London City Lionesses and Chelsea by an aggregate score of 7-1 in the first two league games. Bones were picked out of Olid’s tactics, referendums delivered on the squad and the Spanish coach’s credentials for English top-flight football were questioned. [...] United once again dominated possession throughout the first half and for large parts of the second, yet struggled to carve out clear-cut chances and to convert the ones they did produce. They registered an xG (expected goals) figure of 1.94, with 18 shots in total and 36 touches in the Villa penalty area, three times more than their hosts had in theirs. Even so, the 1-0 win felt tight.

The draw was Carrick's third match in charge since the board decided to give the 45-year-old more time to improve the side's form after a 3-0 home defeat by Bournemouth on 25 October.

The board felt Carrick - and the players - had earned the opportunity to show that they could turn the club's fortunes around, while the heirachy were also aware that November's two-week break would offer an opportunity to reassess the situation in a calmer manner. ## Manchester United are a team for everybody at the moment [...] What wonderful, spectacular nonsense. How else to describe Manchester United’s 4-4 draw with Aston Villa on Sunday?

United made mistake after mistake at Old Trafford, finding themselves 2-0 down after four minutes and then 4-2 behind as stoppage time began. But they found a way back, equalising with almost the last kick of the game.

items.title: Michael Carrick: Manchester United expected to sack head coach - BBC Sport
items.summary:
The following week, United were losing to Ipswich - another newly promoted side. Only a slip from Marcelino Nunez inside his own half allowed Cunha to tee up Fernandes for an undeserved equaliser.

The Portugal playmaker, who had just been crowned PFA Player of the Year for 2025-26, went on to complete a hat-trick in a 5-2 win.

He has scored just once - a penalty against Villa on Sunday - in the league since.

After the Ipswich win came a trip to Everton. [...] By the time of Martinez's outburst, Sesko and left-back Luke Shaw were injured. Marcus Rashford has not played since. The rotation at left-back that eventually led to Carrick starting five different players in that role was in full swing.

After conceding in the opening minute against Atletico, Como scored inside the first two in a 4-1 Champions League defeat for United. Fernandes came out afterwards and criticised Carrick's tactics. [...] After taking a 2-0 lead inside 10 minutes against Brighton in the EFL Cup, United were outplayed and beaten, thanks to two goals in four second-half minutes.

The fine margins United benefited from during Carrick's interim spell were now going against them, and his coaching staff - lauded months earlier - could not find an answer.

items.title: Man Utd Women are unbeaten in 11 games but there is still a striking issue to fix - The Athletic
items.summary:
Two months later, United are fifth in the table with three wins from their past five matches, four points off London City, who fill the third and final Champions League spot.

Sunday’s game encapsulated a lot of United’s improvements in recent months, as well as the struggles that still need to be addressed. [...] Because there was a time two months ago that United’s capacity to win was doubted, Olid’s start to life in the job blighted by a failure to win any of her four pre-season matches, followed by defeats against London City Lionesses and Chelsea by an aggregate score of 7-1 in the first two league games. Bones were picked out of Olid’s tactics, referendums delivered on the squad and the Spanish coach’s credentials for English top-flight football were questioned. [...] United once again dominated possession throughout the first half and for large parts of the second, yet struggled to carve out clear-cut chances and to convert the ones they did produce. They registered an xG (expected goals) figure of 1.94, with 18 shots in total and 36 touches in the Villa penalty area, three times more than their hosts had in theirs. Even so, the 1-0 win felt tight.

items.title: Michael Carrick: Manchester United yet to make decision on whether to sack manager - BBC Sport
items.summary:
The draw was Carrick's third match in charge since the board decided to give the 45-year-old more time to improve the side's form after a 3-0 home defeat by Bournemouth on 25 October.

The board felt Carrick - and the players - had earned the opportunity to show that they could turn the club's fortunes around, while the heirachy were also aware that November's two-week break would offer an opportunity to reassess the situation in a calmer manner. [...] "He gives a penalty away. He knows that. Maybe he can do a little bit better. He made a mistake. But I like what he brings to the team. He cares an awful lot and he's giving everything."
